audience.text: C++ developers building desktop or server applications that need to generate or process Excel-compatible .xlsx files without external runtime dependencies.

capabilities.text: Construct blank workbooks or load existing ones from file paths or in-memory streams, then save back to .xlsx format using Workbook.Save().
capabilities.title: Create and save .xlsx workbooks

capabilities.text: Set cell values with PutValue() accepting strings, integers, doubles, bools, and DateTime; retrieve values via GetValue(); and manage formulas with SetFormula() and GetFormula().
capabilities.title: Read and write cell values and formulas

capabilities.text: Modify cell appearance using Style objects that bundle Font, Borders, FillPattern, foreground/background colors, alignment, and number formats.
capabilities.title: Apply cell styles and formatting

capabilities.text: Control visibility, zoom, gridlines, headers, right-to-left layout, and protection settings per worksheet.
capabilities.title: Manage worksheet structure and view

capabilities.text: Define rule-driven formatting via FormatCondition and input constraints via Validation, both scoped to CellArea ranges.
capabilities.title: Apply conditional formatting and data validation

capabilities.text: Set paper size, orientation, margins, scaling, print area/titles, headers/footers, and page breaks using PageSetup.
capabilities.title: Configure page setup and print settings

capabilities.text: Attach hyperlinks to cells and define workbook- or sheet-scoped named ranges with optional comments.
capabilities.title: Manage hyperlinks and defined names

capabilities.text: Read and write core and extended metadata through WorkbookProperties and DocumentProperties.
capabilities.title: Access document properties

limitations.text: Only .xlsx (OOXML) format is supported for loading and saving; saving to other formats throws UnsupportedFeatureException.
Legacy SpreadsheetML (Excel 2003 XML) is not implemented; mapper classes unconditionally throw UnsupportedFeatureException.
Cell-level comments/notes are not modeled as a distinct object; only DefinedName has a Comment field.
Some advanced conditional-formatting rule types are dropped with a WarningInfo during load rather than preserved.
AutoFilter date-group filters using certain patterns are rejected as unsupported during load.
Prebuilt binaries are available only for Windows with MSVC toolset; Linux and macOS require building from source.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook creation and manipulation in C++ without requiring Microsoft Excel or proprietary runtime libraries.
Provides a familiar API surface for developers experienced with Aspose.Cells commercial products, using Workbook, Worksheet, and Cell objects.
Supports in-memory workbook loading and saving via std::vector<uint8_t> streams for non-filesystem data sources.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for C++ is a dependency-free, header-and-source C++17 library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported AutoFilter patterns and which date-group filters are rejected is not detailed beyond the general statement.
Whether conditional formatting rules that are dropped during load are logged with specific diagnostic severity is not clarified.
The behavior when loading malformed or partially corrupted .xlsx files beyond InvalidFileFormatException is not specified.
The extent of locale-specific number formatting support via DisplayTextFormatter is not detailed beyond the presence of locale support symbols.
The handling of shared formulas or array formulas beyond basic formula text is not explicitly described.
Whether hyperlinks with internal sheet references beyond address strings are fully supported is not confirmed beyond the Hyperlink type presence.
The behavior of Style cloning or inheritance across cells is not detailed beyond GetStyle/SetStyle methods.
The exact scope of workbook-level vs worksheet-level protection features exposed is not fully itemized beyond WorksheetProtection.

workflows.name: Create and style a workbook
workflows.text: Construct a Workbook, access the first Worksheet, populate cells with values and formulas, apply header styling using Style and Font, and save to an .xlsx file.

workflows.name: Load and inspect an existing workbook
workflows.text: Load a workbook from a file path or in-memory stream, iterate over worksheets and cells, and read cell values and formulas.

workflows.name: Apply conditional formatting and validation
workflows.text: Add conditional formatting rules and data validation constraints to cell ranges using ConditionalFormattingCollection and ValidationCollection.

workflows.name: Configure page setup for printing
workflows.text: Set paper size, orientation, margins, print area, headers/footers, and page breaks via the PageSetup interface.
